name: Sky-Dweller Stainless Steel / White Gold / White
movement: Rolex caliber 9001 Hours, Minutes, Seconds, Additional 24 Hour Hand (adjustable) | Date, Annual Calendar, Month | Chronometer
description:
The Rolex Oyster Perpetual Sky-Dweller was introduced in 2012 and is one of Rolex' most complicated watches to date. It features an annual calendar and a second time zone function. The former has a regular date display, while the month is displayed through apertures by the hour markers. The latter is indicated through an off-centre 24h disc at 6 o'clock. The well-known fluted bezel functions as sort of a gear box with three positions, enabling the user to set the date, local time and second time zone through one single position on the crown.
Reference 326934-0001 has a case in stainless steel. It is fitted with a white gold bezel.

Reference 2201.50.00 has a 42mm case with a black bezel inlay. It is fitted with a stainless steel bracelet. It was one of the most popular configurations of the first generation Planet Ocean.
This is the watch worn by Daniel Craig in the 2008 James Bond Quantum of Solace movie.

movement: Hamilton caliber H-50 ND Hours, Minutes, Seconds
description: The Hamilton Khaki Field Mechanical H89409980 debuted in 2025 as a Tokyo Cat Street exclusive edition. The watch has a stainless steel case of 38 mm in diameter and 9.5 mm in height, with a water resistance rating of 50 meters. The grey dial features a concrete-like textured surface with subtle paw-print details referencing the Cat Street boutique, while the reverse side shows an engraved “Hipster Cat” motif. Time is displayed with luminous hands and markers under a sapphire crystal. The watch is delivered on a striped black and dark grey NATO strap, with an additional solid black NATO strap included. Power comes from the hand-wound caliber H-50 ND, which ticks at 21,600 vibrations per hour and offers a power reserve of 80 hours.

name: Cubitus Instantaneous Grand Date Platinum / Blue
movement: Patek Philippe caliber 240 PS CI J LU Hours, Minutes, Small Seconds | Date, Big Date, Day | Moonphase
description:
The Patek Philippe Cubitus Ref. 5822P-001 debuted in 2024 as part of the inaugural Cubitus collection, the manufacture’s first entirely new line since the introduction of the Aquanaut. This reference introduces a high-complication configuration within the Cubitus family, combining an instantaneous grand date, day display, and moon-phase indication.
The watch is housed in a square-shaped platinum case with rounded edges and integrated side attachments, measuring 45 mm across (10–4 o’clock) and 9.6 mm in thickness. The case and bezel feature alternating polished and vertically satin-brushed surfaces. A single baguette-cut diamond is set into the case at 6 o’clock. Water resistance is rated to 30 metres. The watch is fitted with a screw-down crown and a sapphire crystal case back.
The dial features a sunburst blue finish with a horizontally embossed pattern. Time is indicated by applied white gold baton-style hour markers and matching rounded baton-style hands, all filled with white luminescent material. A double-aperture grand date is positioned at 12 o’clock, with the day indicated by hand and the moon-phase display integrated into the layout. A small seconds subdial is located at 6 o’clock.
Powering the watch is the self-winding Caliber 240 PS CI J LU. The movement measures 31 mm in diameter and 4.76 mm in thickness, comprises 353 components and 52 jewels, and operates at a frequency of 21,600 semi-oscillations per hour. It delivers a power reserve of approximately 38 to 48 hours. Winding is provided by a 22K gold off-centre mini-rotor. Regulation is handled by a Gyromax balance with a Spiromax balance spring. The movement incorporates six patented mechanisms related to the instantaneous calendar displays and is finished in accordance with the Patek Philippe Seal.
The watch is delivered on a navy blue composite strap with a fabric-patterned surface and contrasting stitching, secured by a platinum Cubitus fold-over clasp.

name: Cubitus Date 45 Stainless Steel / Green
movement: Patek Philippe caliber 26‑330 S C Hours, Minutes, Seconds | Date
description:
The Patek Philippe Cubitus Ref. 5821/1A-001 debuted in 2024 as part of the inaugural Cubitus collection, marking the manufacture’s first entirely new line since the introduction of the Aquanaut. The model is housed in a stainless steel square-shaped case with rounded edges and integrated side attachments, measuring 45 mm across (10–4 o’clock) and 8.3 mm in thickness. The case, bezel, and bracelet combine polished and vertically satin-brushed surfaces. Water resistance is rated to 30 metres, and the watch is fitted with a screw-down crown and sapphire crystal case back.
The dial features a sunburst olive green finish with a horizontally embossed pattern. Time is indicated by applied white gold baton-style hour markers and matching rounded baton-style hands, both filled with white luminescent material. A framed date aperture is positioned at 3 o’clock, and a central sweep seconds hand completes the display.
Powering the watch is the self-winding Caliber 26-330 S C. The movement measures 27 mm in diameter and 3.32 mm in thickness, comprises 212 components and 30 jewels, and operates at a frequency of 28,800 semi-oscillations per hour. It offers a power reserve of approximately 35 to 45 hours and incorporates a stop-seconds mechanism. Winding is provided by a 21K gold central rotor, and regulation is handled by a Gyromax balance with a Spiromax balance spring. The movement bears the Patek Philippe Seal.
The integrated stainless steel bracelet is secured by a patented Patek Philippe fold-over clasp with a lockable adjustment system.
